style: Make one square image (1:1). Style: a tactile paper-craft 3D icon, as if built by hand from thick matte card and kraft paper for a market stall. Soft rounded edges, visible layered paper edges, very fine paper grain, soft even light from the top left, gentle shading, no glossy highlights. Use only these colours: manila yellow #E9C46A, ink navy #1C2547, stamp red #C7322B, cash green #23764A, cream #F7F0DC, pale blue-grey #C9D1DF. One subject (or a tight little group), three-quarter view, centred, filling about 80% of the square, nothing cut off at the edges. No words, letters, numbers or logos. No floor, no cast shadow, no scene behind it.

groups.title: Style test
groups.note: Make these 3 first. If you like how they look together, carry on. If not, tell me and we adjust the style before making the rest.
